title: Fix Python Import Errors
instructions: Fix the Python import errors so that `python main.py --help` works correctly. The main issues are: missing __init__.py files in package directories, relative imports failing when running as a script, and potential corrupted files from previous edits.

1783339164.6129656.instruction: Modify the IrcConnection class in client/connection.py to replace the hardcoded AF_INET socket creation with socket.getaddrinfo(). This will allow the system to resolve both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. The getaddrinfo call should pass the host, port, and use AF_UNSPEC to get all available address families. Then iterate through the results and try to connect to each address until one succeeds.

1783339166.6028326.instruction: In the IrcConnection.connect() method, when creating the socket, check if the address family is AF_INET6. If so, create the socket with IPV6_V6ONLY set to 0 to allow dual-stack support on systems that support it. This ensures the socket can handle both IPv4 and IPv6 traffic if needed.

1783339168.66733.instruction: Modify the BncServerConfig class in config/settings.py to support IPv6 bind addresses. Update the bind_host default from "0.0.0.0" to support "::" (IPv6 any address) or "::ffff:0.0.0.0" (dual-stack). Also ensure the BNC server can accept connections on both IPv4 and IPv6 if configured.

1783339170.4753275.instruction: Modify the get_stats() method in IrcConnection class to include the address family (IPv4 or IPv6) of the current connection. This helps with debugging and verifying that IPv6 connections are working correctly.

1785958274.2387862.instruction: Create __init__.py files in the config, client, server, and shared directories if they are missing. These files should export the main classes/functions so that `from config import Config, IrcNetworkConfig, BncServerConfig` works.

log.text: Starting task: checking for missing __init__.py files in package directories

1785958277.156776.instruction: Find all relative imports (from ..config, from ..shared, from ..client, from .connection) in client/, server/, and shared/ directories and convert them to absolute imports (from config, from shared, from client, from client.connection). This is needed because the application is run as a script (`python main.py`) rather than as a module.

log.text: Starting task: converting relative imports to absolute imports

1785958281.848345.instruction: Check files that may have been corrupted by previous bulk edits (especially server/bnc_commands.py and any file with syntax errors). Read them and rewrite if necessary to ensure valid Python syntax.

log.text: Starting task: verifying and fixing potentially corrupted files

1785958285.2013752.instruction: Run `python main.py --help` to verify all import errors are resolved. If there are still errors, identify and fix them until the command runs successfully.
